themes.title: Difficulty keeping up daily prayer and community worship
themes.interpretation: The student may feel a loss in being able to practice their faith openly, and may feel they have to hide a part of themselves.

evidence.quote: I used to pray five times a day with my community, and here I do it in the library stairwell.
There is no prayer room on campus that I know of

themes.title: Starting to study too late before exams
themes.interpretation: The student describes planning to start early and then running out of time, and mentions that a parent used to keep the schedule at home.

evidence.quote: I keep starting to study too late.

recommendations.topic: Explore how the student practices their faith here
recommendations.open_question: What would make it easier to keep your prayer routine?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Find out whether the school has a multi-faith space and offer to help them ask for one.
based_on_titles: Difficulty keeping up daily prayer and community worship

recommendations.open_question: What does your week look like before the exams?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Teach a simple weekly planning method and check in on how it went next session.
based_on_titles: Starting to study too late before exams
